titulo: Jonah and the Little Plant 🌱 | Bible Story for Kids #shorts
descricao:
Jonah is grumpy because God forgave Nineveh. So God uses a little plant to teach Jonah about his great love for everyone. Told by Mel the little sheep.

📖 Reference: Jonah 4
💛 Lesson: God loves all people, and we should love them too.

falas.texto: Hi, little friend! Today a little plant gives a lesson!
God forgave Nineveh. But Jonah was grumpy.
Humph! I didn't want God to forgive them!
He sat outside the city, in the warm sun.
God made a big plant grow. What nice shade!
Yay! What a great plant! I love it!
The next day, a little worm chewed the plant. It dried up.
The sun got hot, and the wind blew hard.
Oh no! My little plant! How sad!
Jonah, you felt sorry for the little plant, didn't you?
Shouldn't I feel sorry for Nineveh, with so many people and animals?
You're right, Lord. You love everyone!
God loves all people. Let's love them too!
Bye, little friend! God loves you!
